color_space: scene-linear Rec.709/sRGB primaries before view transform
normalization: No source scaling applied at this export stage
limitations: Authored coastal clear daylight settings, not measured weather/time.
Native renderer uses a uniform disk matched to model residual irradiance; solar limb darkening is not retained.
RGB export must be colorimetrically fitted to native LIGHT spectral controls; it is not an original spectral radiance export.
Panoramic source is directionally resampled to native Y-pole texture coordinates.
